chapter_seo_title: RMJI Ch. 290: Han Li Enters the Prince of Xin’s Mansion – A Deadly Social Game
chapter_meta_description: Han Li arrives at the Prince of Xin's mansion for a grand banquet. But a cold shiver from the palace steward warns him that the real danger here isn't swords—it's a game of social tribulation.
og_description: The Mortal Stream’s deadliest battlefield isn’t always a forest of thorns. Sometimes it’s a high-society banquet where every smile is a weapon.
twitter_title: A Noble Feast Hides a Social Tribulation
twitter_description: Han Li walks into the Prince of Xin’s mansion and feels a predator’s gaze. The fighting style just changed.

lore_anchors.definition: A renowned healing pill concocted by Physician Hua; effective against common ailments and minor injuries, its name carries considerable weight in the Yue Capital.
A powerful imperial prince of the Yue Kingdom, member of the royal family; his mansion is one of the largest and most heavily guarded in the Southern District.
One of the two great physicians of the Yue Capital, known for his open-mindedness and exceptional medical skill; a friend and peer of Qin Yan.
The official residential zone of the Yue Capital, where houses are strictly allocated according to official rank and noble title, making status instantly legible.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why does Han Li feel a chill from the palace steward?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The steward triggers Han Li’s survival instinct as if a demonic beast were nearby, even though no spiritual energy is detected—this signals an unseen threat or hidden cultivation level that Han Li’s subconscious recognizes.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is the significance of the Heart-Protecting Pills?
cultural_notes_faq.a: They are a famous healing pill from a top physician, marking Han Li’s acceptance into the capital’s elite circle and providing a valuable mortal-world asset for future emergencies.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Is this chapter just filler before a fight?
cultural_notes_faq.a: No—it is a classic “social tribulation” setup, establishing the political landscape, introducing key power players, and building atmospheric dread for a conflict that will be fought with words and wits, not magic.
